name: Destructive Wave

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

targets.description: creatures of your choice in the Emanation

summary: A 30-foot blast around you: Con save or 5d6 Thunder plus 5d6 Radiant or Necrotic and Prone; half damage on a success.
text: Only creatures you choose in the Emanation are affected. You pick Radiant or Necrotic when you cast.
